headline: Eswatini and AICE Africa Launch AI Safety and Standards Centre
summary: The Eswatini Standards Authority and AICE Africa established an AI Safety and Standards Centre of Excellence to build African capacity in governing and certifying artificial intelligence systems.
why: Emerging technology regulations and standardization centers influence compliance requirements and tech sector development across regional markets.

impacts.name: Technology sector
impacts.why: New standards center affects AI system governance and certification.
